thread:
ashley: Quick ask — PR #70123 is ready for runtime/platform/security review. Need a merge steward + security signoff before Friday canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/70123. TL;DR: adds adaptive routing config + fallback policy.

sam: :eyes: I can take runtime review tomorrow morning. Are there perf regressions expected?

ashley: No perf regressions in unit tests; we saw a small bump in staging 99p (~3ms). Perf logs attached in the PR: `perf/staging/70123.log`.

lee: Can you add a short canary plan? Who owns rollback? Also we need a quick e2e on canary traffic.

ashley: Added canary plan in the PR description — 10% traffic for 2h, monitor latency, 5xx rate, token throughput. Rollback: revert canary flag + traffic reroute (ops owns).

olga: Security note — there's an auth header order change in the dispatcher. I'll review; if it touches KMS/crypto I'll take the KMS review. ETA EOD.

deploy-bot: Deploy window proposed: Fri 09:00-11:00 UTC canary slot if approvals are in.

sam: I'll validate KV cache behavior and continuous-batching interactions tomorrow. If perf looks stable I'll LGTM. ETA ~11:30 UTC.

lee: @ashley please add owners for rollback and on-call coverage in the PR so we have an escalation path.

ashley: Done — added `@ops_oncall` and `@sam` as rollback owners. Also pasted canary runner commands in the PR: 
```
# canary traffic generator
./tools/canary --target pr-70123 --qps 120 --duration 2h
```

olga: :thumbsup: Found one minor header-order caveat, pushed a tiny fix to the branch. Will mark security approved once CI is green.

sam: Re-ran perf with the fix, tail looks fine. LGTM from runtime.

ashley: :tada: Thanks all. If anyone sees blockers speak up, otherwise I'll queue the merge for the Friday canary window and hand off stewarding to @ops_oncall.
